{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_6]
Query: Draft an email to my supervisor with the file path that failed to open in this VS Code error message, and the IP address it was trying to connect to.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to draft an email to your supervisor containing the file path and IP address from the VS Code error message shown on the screen. If the assistant asks for your supervisor's name, remind it to check your profile. If it misreads the path or IP, point it back to the terminal or error popup in the images. Once the draft is successfully created, move to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_2, image_5]
Query: Update that draft to also include the Vivado project location and the project part number shown in the summary here.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to update the email draft from the previous turn by adding the Vivado project location and the project part number visible in the newly provided screenshots. If the assistant includes incorrect details, correct it by referring to the Project Summary panel. Once the draft is updated, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_4]
Query: Actually, change of plan. Delete that email draft. Instead, create a new folder called 'Project_Issue' and make a text file inside it named 'issue_details.txt'. In that file, put the VS Code error path, the Vivado project location, and the name of the video decoder IP core selected in this catalog.
Instructions: Tell the assistant that you've changed your mind. Ask it to delete the email draft completely. Then, instruct it to create a new directory named 'Project_Issue' and create a file called 'issue_details.txt' within it. The file should contain the VS Code error path, the Vivado project location, and the name of the video decoder IP core highlighted in the provided image. If the assistant forgets to delete the draft or misses any details for the text file, remind it to check the images again. Once all actions are confirmed, move to the next round.

ROUND 4 [provide: image_3]
Query: Now, copy the 'PPT模板' directory from the postgraduate folder path shown on my desktop into the new 'Project_Issue' folder so I can prepare a presentation about this issue.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to copy the 'PPT模板' folder from the path displayed on the right side of your desktop into the newly created 'Project_Issue' directory. If it asks for the source path, tell it to look at the floating directory panels on the screen. Once the folder has been successfully copied, conclude the conversation.
